SELECT c.id, c.video_id, c.user_id, c.parent_id, c.root_id, c.content, c.like_count, c.reply_count, c.status, c.create_time, u.nike_name, u.avatar,
(CASE WHEN cl.status = 1 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END) AS liked
FALSE AS liked
FROM public.comment c LEFT JOIN public.user_info u ON c.user_id = u.id
LEFT JOIN public.comment_like cl ON c.id = cl.comment_id AND cl.user_id = #{currentUserId}
WHERE c.video_id = #{videoId} AND c.parent_id = 0 AND c.status != 2
ORDER BY c.like_count DESC, c.create_time DESC
ORDER BY c.create_time DESC

SELECT c.id, c.video_id, c.user_id, c.parent_id, c.root_id, c.content, c.like_count, c.reply_count, c.status, c.create_time, u.nike_name, u.avatar,
(CASE WHEN cl.status = 1 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END) AS liked
FALSE AS liked
FROM public.comment c LEFT JOIN public.user_info u ON c.user_id = u.id
LEFT JOIN public.comment_like cl ON c.id = cl.comment_id AND cl.user_id = #{currentUserId}
WHERE c.root_id = #{rootId} AND c.parent_id != 0 AND c.status != 2 ORDER BY c.create_time ASC

SELECT c.id, c.video_id, c.user_id, c.parent_id, c.root_id, c.content, c.like_count, c.reply_count, c.status, c.create_time, u.nike_name, u.avatar, v.title AS video_title, v.cover_url AS video_cover, FALSE AS liked FROM public.comment c LEFT JOIN public.user_info u ON c.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN public.video_info v ON c.video_id = v.id
AND c.video_id = #{videoId}
AND c.status = #{status}
AND c.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND u.nike_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{nickName}, '%')
AND c.create_time >= TO_TIMESTAMP(#{startTime}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
AND c.create_time <= TO_TIMESTAMP(#{endTime}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS')
ORDER BY c.create_time DESC

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS normal_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS user_deleted_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS admin_blocked_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pending_review_count, COUNT(*) AS total_count FROM public.comment

SELECT c.id, c.video_id, c.user_id, c.parent_id, c.root_id, c.content, c.like_count, c.reply_count, c.status, c.create_time, u.nike_name, u.avatar, v.title AS video_title, v.cover_url AS video_cover, FALSE AS liked FROM public.comment c LEFT JOIN public.user_info u ON c.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN public.video_info v ON c.video_id = v.id WHERE c.status = 3
AND c.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{content}, '%')
AND u.nike_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{nickName}, '%')
AND v.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{videoTitle}, '%')
ORDER BY c.create_time DESC
SELECT create_time::date AS "date", COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM public.comment WHERE create_time::date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '6 days' GROUP BY create_time::date ORDER BY "date"
